name: Hesperian-Reach
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by solar wind erosion patterns and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
For traders, iron alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
